selection_stage: Before extracting candidate sample values or canonical comparison measurements; after source documentation and access reconnaissance
purpose: Purposive measurement-semantics audit; no population coverage estimator or model diagnostic
selection_rule: Fixed named bouts spanning legacy history, training-era history, outer years and contrasting public fight characteristics. Resolve exact identities/dates from pinned canonical tables; no replacement based on candidate source values. One 2026 sentinel is the earliest dated UFC bout in 2026, ordered by fight_id within its event date, without using outcomes or model evidence.
boundary: Only event dates <= 2026-08-15; no prospective model predictions or confirmation results read
match_ambiguity_rule: If more than one match in specified year, choose earliest by event date before viewing candidate values; flag ambiguity. No candidate-driven replacements.
supplemental_example: Sportradar documentation-selected Garry-Prates 2025 example is separate convenience evidence, not part of the predeclared panel or evidence of population coverage.
